import trimesh, numpy as np, math

# --- 1. Crown flat contact width of the hanger (print coords) ---
h = trimesh.load('exports/model.hanger.bb97b27d.stl')
# topmost point for each z column at x=0: sweep rays downward at x=0
zs = np.linspace(0.05, 33.95, 680)
origins = np.column_stack([np.zeros_like(zs), np.full_like(zs, 60.0), zs])
dirs = np.tile([0.0, -1.0, 0.0], (len(zs), 1))
loc, rid, tid = h.ray.intersects_location(origins, dirs, multiple_hits=True)
top_y = np.full(len(zs), -1.0)
for i, loc_i in enumerate(loc):
    top_y[rid[i]] = max(top_y[rid[i]], loc_i[1])
crown = top_y.max()
flat = zs[top_y > crown - 0.05]
print(f'crown y at x=0: {crown:.3f} mm (assembly height = 228.5 + y)')
print(f'crown flat width within 0.05mm of top: z {flat.min():.2f}..{flat.max():.2f} -> {flat.max()-flat.min():.2f} mm')
contact = zs[top_y > crown - 1.0]
print(f'contact band within 1mm of crown: {contact.max()-contact.min():.2f} mm wide')

# --- 2. Tipping analysis (assembly coords) ---
rho = 1.24  # PLA g/cm3
parts = {
    'base':   ('exports/model.base.87e59dfb.stl',   [0, 0, 0]),
    'post':   ('exports/model.post.2b1e5522.stl',   [0, 0, 14.5]),
    'hanger': ('exports/model.hanger.bb97b27d.stl', None),
}
tot_m, tot_mx, tot_my = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
for name, (path, off) in parts.items():
    m = trimesh.load(path)
    if name == 'hanger':  # print -> assembly: (x, 17-z_print, 228.5+y_print)
        v = m.vertices[:, ::-1] * [1, 1, 0]  # placeholder, rotate properly below
        T = np.eye(4)
        T[:3, :3] = np.array([[1, 0, 0], [0, 0, -1], [0, 1, 0]], float)
        T[:3, 3] = [0, 17.0, 228.5]
        m.apply_transform(T)
    else:
        m.apply_translation(off)
    com = m.center_mass
    mass = m.volume * rho / 1000.0
    print(f'{name}: {mass:.0f} g, COM=({com[0]:.1f}, {com[1]:.1f}, {com[2]:.1f})')
    tot_m += mass; tot_mx += mass * com[0]; tot_my += mass * com[1]
stand_x, stand_y = tot_mx / tot_m, tot_my / tot_m
phone = 350.0  # g of headphones, hung centred on saddle (worst realistic offset 30 mm sideways)
for off_x, off_y, label in [(0, 0, 'centred'), (30, 0, '30mm to the side'), (0, 45, '45mm front'), (35, 45, 'corner')]:
    cx = (tot_m * stand_x + phone * off_x) / (tot_m + phone)
    cy = (tot_m * stand_y + phone * off_y) / (tot_m + phone)
    margin = min(94 - abs(cx), 80 - abs(cy))
    print(f'headphones {label}: combined COM ({cx:.1f}, {cy:.1f}); margin to base edge {margin:.1f} mm')
print(f'stand alone: {tot_m:.0f} g, COM ({stand_x:.1f}, {stand_y:.1f})')
